nodes.description: Analyze specifications, lay out metal stock, set up and operate machine tools, and fit and assemble parts to make and repair dies, cutting tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and machinists' hand tools.

nodes.name: Soldadores
nodes.description: Use hand-welding, flame-cutting, hand-soldering, or brazing equipment to weld or join metal components or to fill holes, indentations, or seams of fabricated metal products.

nodes.name: Operadores de máquinas de soldar
nodes.en: Welding, Soldering, and Brazing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend welding, soldering, or brazing machines or robots that weld, braze, solder, or heat treat metal products, components, or assemblies. Includes workers who operate laser cutters or laser-beam machines.

nodes.name: operarios de tratamiento térmico
nodes.en: Heat Treating Equipment Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend heating equipment, such as heat-treating furnaces, flame-hardening machines, induction machines, soaking pits, or vacuum equipment to temper, harden, anneal, or heat treat metal or plastic objects.

nodes.name: trazadores
nodes.description: Lay out reference points and dimensions on metal or plastic stock or workpieces, such as sheets, plates, tubes, structural shapes, castings, or machine parts, for further processing. Includes shipfitters.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de galvanoplastia
nodes.en: Plating Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend plating machines to coat metal or plastic products with chromium, zinc, copper, cadmium, nickel, or other metal to protect or decorate surfaces. Typically, the product being coated is immersed in molten metal or an electrolytic solution.

nodes.name: afiladores de herramientas
nodes.description: Perform precision smoothing, sharpening, polishing, or grinding of metal objects.

nodes.name: técnicos de preimpresión
nodes.description: Format and proof text and images submitted by designers and clients into finished pages that can be printed. Includes digital and photo typesetting. May produce printing plates.

nodes.name: operarios de imprenta
nodes.description: Set up and operate digital, letterpress, lithographic, flexographic, gravure, or other printing machines. Includes short-run offset printing presses.

nodes.name: trabajadores de encuadernación y acabado
nodes.description: Bind books and other publications or finish printed products by hand or machine. May set up binding and finishing machines.

nodes.name: trabajadores de lavandería y tintorería
nodes.description: Operate or tend washing or dry-cleaning machines to wash or dry-clean industrial or household articles, such as cloth garments, suede, leather, furs, blankets, draperies, linens, rugs, and carpets. Includes spotters and dyers of these articles.

nodes.name: planchadores
nodes.en: Pressers, Textile, Garment, and Related Materials
nodes.description: Press or shape articles by hand or machine.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de coser
nodes.description: Operate or tend sewing machines to join, reinforce, decorate, or perform related sewing operations in the manufacture of garment or nongarment products.

nodes.name: reparadores de calzado y artículos de cuero
nodes.en: Shoe and Leather Workers and Repairers
nodes.description: Construct, decorate, or repair leather and leather-like products, such as luggage, shoes, and saddles. May use hand tools.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas para calzado
nodes.description: Operate or tend a variety of machines to join, decorate, reinforce, or finish shoes and shoe parts.

nodes.name: costureros a mano
nodes.description: Sew, join, reinforce, or finish, usually with needle and thread, a variety of manufactured items. Includes weavers and stitchers.

nodes.name: sastres y modistas
nodes.description: Design, make, alter, repair, or fit garments.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de blanqueo y teñido textil
nodes.en: Textile Bleaching and Dyeing Machine Operators and Tenders
nodes.description: Operate or tend machines to bleach, shrink, wash, dye, or finish textiles or synthetic or glass fibers.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de corte textil
nodes.en: Textile Cutting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines that cut textiles.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de tejer y teular textil
nodes.en: Textile Knitting and Weaving Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines that knit, loop, weave, or draw in textiles.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de hilar y torcer textil
nodes.en: Textile Winding, Twisting, and Drawing Out Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines that wind or twist textiles; or draw out and combine sliver, such as wool, hemp, or synthetic fibers. Includes slubber machine and drawing frame operators.

nodes.name: operarios de extrusión de fibras sintéticas y vidrio
nodes.en: Extruding and Forming Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Synthetic and Glass Fibers
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines that extrude and form continuous filaments from synthetic materials, such as liquid polymer, rayon, and fiberglass.

nodes.name: patronistas de textiles y prendas
nodes.description: Draw and construct sets of precision master fabric patterns or layouts. May also mark and cut fabrics and apparel.

nodes.name: tapiceros
nodes.description: Make, repair, or replace upholstery for household furniture or transportation vehicles.

nodes.name: ebanistas
nodes.description: Cut, shape, and assemble wooden articles or set up and operate a variety of woodworking machines, such as power saws, jointers, and mortisers to surface, cut, or shape lumber or to fabricate parts for wood products.

nodes.name: lustradores de muebles
nodes.description: Shape, finish, and refinish damaged, worn, or used furniture or new high-grade furniture to specified color or finish.

nodes.name: modelistas de madera
nodes.description: Construct full-size and scale wooden precision models of products. Includes wood jig builders and loft workers.

nodes.name: patronistas de madera
nodes.description: Plan, lay out, and construct wooden unit or sectional patterns used in forming sand molds for castings.

nodes.name: operarios de sierras para madera
nodes.en: Sawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Wood
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend wood sawing machines. May operate computer numerically controlled (CNC) equipment. Includes lead sawyers.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas para madera
nodes.en: Woodworking Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Except Sawing
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend woodworking machines, such as drill presses, lathes, shapers, routers, sanders, planers, and wood nailing machines. May operate computer numerically controlled (CNC) equipment.

nodes.name: operadores de reactores nucleares
nodes.description: Operate or control nuclear reactors. Move control rods, start and stop equipment, monitor and adjust controls, and record data in logs. Implement emergency procedures when needed. May respond to abnormalities, determine cause, and recommend corrective action.

nodes.name: distribuidores y despachantes de energía
nodes.description: Coordinate, regulate, or distribute electricity or steam.

nodes.name: operadores de centrales eléctricas
nodes.description: Control, operate, or maintain machinery to generate electric power. Includes auxiliary equipment operators.

nodes.name: técnicos de plantas de biomasa
nodes.description: Control and monitor biomass plant activities and perform maintenance as needed.

nodes.name: técnicos de plantas hidroeléctricas
nodes.description: Monitor and control activities associated with hydropower generation. Operate plant equipment, such as turbines, pumps, valves, gates, fans, electric control boards, and battery banks. Monitor equipment operation and performance and make necessary adjustments to ensure optimal performance. Perform equipment maintenance and repair as necessary.

nodes.name: calderistas
nodes.description: Operate or maintain stationary engines, boilers, or other mechanical equipment to provide utilities for buildings or industrial processes. Operate equipment such as steam engines, generators, motors, turbines, and steam boilers.

nodes.name: operarios de plantas de agua
nodes.en: Water and Wastewater Treatment Plant and System Operators
nodes.description: Operate or control an entire process or system of machines, often through the use of control boards, to transfer or treat water or wastewater.

nodes.name: operadores de plantas químicas
nodes.description: Control or operate entire chemical processes or system of machines.

nodes.name: operadores de plantas de gas
nodes.description: Distribute or process gas for utility companies and others by controlling compressors to maintain specified pressures on main pipelines.

nodes.name: operadores de bombas de petróleo
nodes.en: Petroleum Pump System Operators, Refinery Operators, and Gaugers
nodes.description: Operate or control petroleum refining or processing units. May specialize in controlling manifold and pumping systems, gauging or testing oil in storage tanks, or regulating the flow of oil into pipelines.

nodes.name: técnicos de procesamiento de biocombustibles
nodes.description: Calculate, measure, load, mix, and process refined feedstock with additives in fermentation or reaction process vessels and monitor production process. Perform, and keep records of, plant maintenance, repairs, and safety inspections.

nodes.name: operarios de equipos químicos
nodes.description: Operate or tend equipment to control chemical changes or reactions in the processing of industrial or consumer products. Equipment used includes devulcanizers, steam-jacketed kettles, and reactor vessels.

nodes.name: operarios de separación y filtrado
nodes.en: Separating, Filtering, Clarifying, Precipitating, and Still Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend continuous flow or vat-type equipment; filter presses; shaker screens; centrifuges; condenser tubes; precipitating, fermenting, or evaporating tanks; scrubbing towers; or batch stills. These machines extract, sort, or separate liquids, gases, or solids from other materials to recover a refined product. Includes dairy processing equipment operators.

nodes.name: operarios de trituración y pulido
nodes.en: Crushing, Grinding, and Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines to crush, grind, or polish materials, such as coal, glass, grain, stone, food, or rubber.

nodes.name: pulidores a mano
nodes.description: Grind, sand, or polish, using hand tools or hand-held power tools, a variety of metal, wood, stone, clay, plastic, or glass objects. Includes chippers, buffers, and finishers.

nodes.name: operarios de mezcladoras
nodes.en: Mixing and Blending Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines to mix or blend materials, such as chemicals, tobacco, liquids, color pigments, or explosive ingredients.

nodes.name: cortadores a mano
nodes.description: Use hand tools or hand-held power tools to cut and trim a variety of manufactured items, such as carpet, fabric, stone, glass, or rubber.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de corte
nodes.en: Cutting and Slicing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines that cut or slice materials, such as glass, stone, cork, rubber, tobacco, food, paper, or insulating material.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de extrusión y prensado
nodes.en: Extruding, Forming, Pressing, and Compacting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines, such as glass-forming machines, plodder machines, and tuber machines, to shape and form products such as glassware, food, rubber, soap, brick, tile, clay, wax, tobacco, or cosmetics.

nodes.name: operarios de hornos y secadoras
nodes.en: Furnace, Kiln, Oven, Drier, and Kettle Operators and Tenders
nodes.description: Operate or tend heating equipment other than basic metal, plastic, or food processing equipment. Includes activities such as annealing glass, drying lumber, curing rubber, removing moisture from materials, or boiling soap.

nodes.name: inspectores y clasificadores
nodes.en: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
nodes.description: Inspect, test, sort, sample, or weigh nonagricultural raw materials or processed, machined, fabricated, or assembled parts or products for defects, wear, and deviations from specifications. May use precision measuring instruments and complex test equipment.

nodes.name: joyeros
nodes.en: Jewelers and Precious Stone and Metal Workers
nodes.description: Design, fabricate, adjust, repair, or appraise jewelry, gold, silver, other precious metals, or gems.

nodes.name: trabajadores de gemas y diamantes
nodes.description: Fabricate, finish, or evaluate the quality of gems and diamonds used in jewelry or industrial tools.

nodes.name: técnicos dentales
nodes.description: Construct and repair full or partial dentures or dental appliances.

nodes.name: técnicos de aparatos médicos
nodes.description: Construct, maintain, or repair medical supportive devices such as braces, orthotics and prosthetic devices, joints, arch supports, and other surgical and medical appliances.

nodes.name: técnicos de laboratorios oftalmológicos
nodes.description: Cut, grind, and polish eyeglasses, contact lenses, or other precision optical elements. Assemble and mount lenses into frames or process other optical elements. Includes precision lens polishers or grinders, centerer-edgers, and lens mounters.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de envasado
nodes.en: Packaging and Filling Machine Operators and Tenders
nodes.description: Operate or tend machines to prepare industrial or consumer products for storage or shipment. Includes cannery workers who pack food products.

nodes.name: pintores y decoradores
nodes.description: Paint, coat, or decorate articles, such as furniture, glass, plateware, pottery, jewelry, toys, books, or leather.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de pintura
nodes.en: Coating, Painting, and Spraying Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend spraying or rolling machines to coat or paint any of a wide variety of products, including glassware, cloth, ceramics, metal, plastic, paper, or wood, with lacquer, silver, copper, rubber, varnish, glaze, enamel, oil, or rust-proofing materials. Includes painters of transportation vehicles such as painters in auto body repair facilities.

nodes.name: técnicos de procesamiento de semiconductores
nodes.description: Perform any or all of the following functions in the manufacture of electronic semiconductors: load semiconductor material into furnace; saw formed ingots into segments; load individual segment into crystal growing chamber and monitor controls; locate crystal axis in ingot using x-ray equipment and saw ingots into wafers; and clean, polish, and load wafers into series of special purpose furnaces, chemical baths, and equipment used to form circuitry and change conductive properties.

nodes.name: trabajadores de procesos fotográficos
nodes.en: Photographic Process Workers and Processing Machine Operators
nodes.description: Perform work involved in developing and processing photographic images from film or digital media. May perform precision tasks such as editing photographic negatives and prints.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas CNC
nodes.description: Operate computer-controlled tools, machines, or robots to machine or process parts, tools, or other work pieces made of metal, plastic, wood, stone, or other materials. May also set up and maintain equipment.

nodes.name: programadores de máquinas CNC
nodes.description: Develop programs to control machining or processing of materials by automatic machine tools, equipment, or systems. May also set up, operate, or maintain equipment.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de pegado
nodes.en: Adhesive Bonding Machine Operators and Tenders
nodes.description: Operate or tend bonding machines that use adhesives to join items for further processing or to form a completed product. Processes include joining veneer sheets into plywood; gluing paper; or joining rubber and rubberized fabric parts, plastic, simulated leather, or other materials.

nodes.name: operarios de limpieza y decapado de metales
nodes.en: Cleaning, Washing, and Metal Pickling Equipment Operators and Tenders
nodes.description: Operate or tend machines to wash or clean products, such as barrels or kegs, glass items, tin plate, food, pulp, coal, plastic, or rubber, to remove impurities.

nodes.name: operarios de equipos de refrigeración
nodes.en: Cooling and Freezing Equipment Operators and Tenders
nodes.description: Operate or tend equipment such as cooling and freezing units, refrigerators, batch freezers, and freezing tunnels, to cool or freeze products, food, blood plasma, and chemicals.

nodes.name: grabadores
nodes.description: Engrave or etch metal, wood, rubber, or other materials. Includes such workers as etcher-circuit processors, pantograph engravers, and silk screen etchers.

nodes.name: moldeadores y fundidores
nodes.en: Molders, Shapers, and Casters, Except Metal and Plastic
nodes.description: Mold, shape, form, cast, or carve products such as food products, figurines, tile, pipes, and candles consisting of clay, glass, plaster, concrete, stone, or combinations of materials.

nodes.name: cortadores de piedra
nodes.description: Cut or carve stone according to diagrams and patterns.

nodes.name: sopladores de vidrio
nodes.en: Glass Blowers, Molders, Benders, and Finishers
nodes.description: Shape molten glass according to patterns.

nodes.name: ceramistas industriales
nodes.description: Operate production machines such as pug mill, jigger machine, or potter's wheel to process clay in manufacture of ceramic, pottery and stoneware products.

nodes.name: operarios de máquinas de papel
nodes.en: Paper Goods Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
nodes.description: Set up, operate, or tend paper goods machines that perform a variety of functions, such as converting, sawing, corrugating, banding, wrapping, boxing, stitching, forming, or sealing paper or paperboard sheets into products.

nodes.name: armadores de neumáticos
nodes.description: Operate machines to build tires.

nodes.name: ayudantes de producción
nodes.description: Help production workers by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include supplying or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

nodes.name: supervisores de carga aérea
nodes.description: Supervise and coordinate the activities of ground crew in the loading, unloading, securing, and staging of aircraft cargo or baggage. May determine the quantity and orientation of cargo and compute aircraft center of gravity. May accompany aircraft as member of flight crew and monitor and handle cargo in flight, and assist and brief passengers on safety and emergency procedures. Includes loadmasters.

nodes.name: supervisores de ayudantes y peones
nodes.en: First-Line Supervisors of Helpers, Laborers, and Material Movers, Hand
nodes.description: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of helpers, laborers, or material movers, hand.

nodes.name: coordinadores de reciclaje
nodes.description: Supervise curbside and drop-off recycling programs for municipal governments or private firms.

nodes.name: supervisores de operadores de maquinaria
nodes.en: First-Line Supervisors of Material-Moving Machine and Vehicle Operators
nodes.description: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of material-moving machine and vehicle operators and helpers.

nodes.name: supervisores de asistentes de pasajeros
nodes.description: Supervise and coordinate activities of passenger attendants.

nodes.name: pilotos y copilotos
nodes.en: Airline Pilots, Copilots, and Flight Engineers
nodes.description: Pilot and navigate the flight of fixed-wing aircraft, usually on scheduled air carrier routes, for the transport of passengers and cargo. Requires Federal Air Transport certificate and rating for specific aircraft type used. Includes regional, national, and international airline pilots and flight instructors of airline pilots.

nodes.name: pilotos comerciales
nodes.description: Pilot and navigate the flight of fixed-wing aircraft on nonscheduled air carrier routes, or helicopters. Requires Commercial Pilot certificate. Includes charter pilots with similar certification, and air ambulance and air tour pilots. Excludes regional, national, and international airline pilots.

nodes.name: controladores de tráfico aéreo
nodes.description: Control air traffic on and within vicinity of airport, and movement of air traffic between altitude sectors and control centers, according to established procedures and policies. Authorize, regulate, and control commercial airline flights according to government or company regulations to expedite and ensure flight safety.

nodes.name: especialistas en operaciones aeroportuarias
nodes.description: Ensure the safe takeoff and landing of commercial and military aircraft. Duties include coordination between air-traffic control and maintenance personnel, dispatching, using airfield landing and navigational aids, implementing airfield safety procedures, monitoring and maintaining flight records, and applying knowledge of weather information.

nodes.name: tripulantes de cabina
nodes.description: Monitor safety of the aircraft cabin. Provide services to airline passengers, explain safety information, serve food and beverages, and respond to emergency incidents.

nodes.name: conductores de ambulancia
nodes.en: Ambulance Drivers and Attendants, Except Emergency Medical Technicians
nodes.description: Drive ambulance or assist ambulance driver in transporting sick, injured, or convalescent persons. Assist in lifting patients.

nodes.name: repartidores
nodes.description: Drive truck or other vehicle over established routes or within an established territory and sell or deliver goods, such as food products, including restaurant take-out items, or pick up or deliver items such as commercial laundry. May also take orders, collect payment, or stock merchandise at point of delivery.

nodes.name: conductores de camiones pesados
nodes.description: Drive a tractor-trailer combination or a truck with a capacity of at least 26,001 pounds Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW). May be required to unload truck. Requires commercial drivers' license. Includes tow truck drivers.

nodes.name: conductores de camiones livianos
nodes.description: Drive a light vehicle, such as a truck or van, with a capacity of less than 26,001 pounds Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), primarily to pick up merchandise or packages from a distribution center and deliver. May load and unload vehicle.

nodes.name: choferes de ómnibus escolares
nodes.description: Drive a school bus to transport students. Ensure adherence to safety rules. May assist students in boarding or exiting.

nodes.name: choferes de ómnibus de línea
nodes.description: Drive bus or motor coach, including regular route operations, charters, and private carriage. May assist passengers with baggage. May collect fares or tickets.

nodes.name: conductores de traslado
nodes.description: Drive a motor vehicle to transport passengers on a planned or scheduled basis. May collect a fare. Includes nonemergency medical transporters and hearse drivers.

nodes.name: taxistas
nodes.description: Drive a motor vehicle to transport passengers on an unplanned basis and charge a fare, usually based on a meter.

nodes.name: maquinistas de locomotoras
nodes.description: Drive electric, diesel-electric, steam, or gas-turbine-electric locomotives to transport passengers or freight. Interpret train orders, electronic or manual signals, and railroad rules and regulations.

nodes.name: maquinistas de maniobras ferroviarias
nodes.en: Rail Yard Engineers, Dinkey Operators, and Hostlers
nodes.description: Drive switching or other locomotive or dinkey engines within railroad yard, industrial plant, quarry, construction project, or similar location.

nodes.name: operadores de señales y frenos
nodes.en: Railroad Brake, Signal, and Switch Operators and Locomotive Firers
nodes.description: Operate or monitor railroad track switches or locomotive instruments. May couple or uncouple rolling stock to make up or break up trains. Watch for and relay traffic signals. May inspect couplings, air hoses, journal boxes, and hand brakes. May watch for dragging equipment or obstacles on rights-of-way.

nodes.name: guardas y jefes de estación
nodes.description: Coordinate activities of switch-engine crew within railroad yard, industrial plant, or similar location. Conductors coordinate activities of train crew on passenger or freight trains. Yardmasters review train schedules and switching orders and coordinate activities of workers engaged in railroad traffic operations, such as the makeup or breakup of trains and yard switching.

nodes.name: conductores de subte y tranvía
nodes.description: Operate subway or elevated suburban trains with no separate locomotive, or electric-powered streetcar, to transport passengers. May handle fares.

nodes.name: marineros y engrasadores
nodes.description: Stand watch to look for obstructions in path of vessel, measure water depth, turn wheel on bridge, or use emergency equipment as directed by captain, mate, or pilot. Break out, rig, overhaul, and store cargo-handling gear, stationary rigging, and running gear. Perform a variety of maintenance tasks to preserve the painted surface of the ship and to maintain line and ship equipment. Must hold government-issued certification and tankerman certification when working aboard liquid-carrying vessels. Includes able seamen and ordinary seamen.

nodes.name: capitanes y patrones de embarcaciones
nodes.en: Captains, Mates, and Pilots of Water Vessels
nodes.description: Command or supervise operations of ships and water vessels, such as tugboats and ferryboats. Required to hold license issued by U.S. Coast Guard.

nodes.name: operadores de lanchas
nodes.description: Operate small motor-driven boats. May assist in navigational activities.

nodes.name: ingenieros navales
nodes.description: Supervise and coordinate activities of crew engaged in operating and maintaining engines, boilers, deck machinery, and electrical, sanitary, and refrigeration equipment aboard ship.

nodes.name: puentes y esclusas
nodes.description: Operate and tend bridges, canal locks, and lighthouses to permit marine passage on inland waterways, near shores, and at danger points in waterway passages. May supervise such operations. Includes drawbridge operators, lock operators, and slip bridge operators.

nodes.name: estacioneros
nodes.description: Park vehicles or issue tickets for customers in a parking lot or garage. May park or tend vehicles in environments such as a car dealership or rental car facility. May collect fee.

nodes.name: Playeros de estaciones de servicio y náutica
nodes.description: Service automobiles, buses, trucks, boats, and other automotive or marine vehicles with fuel, lubricants, and accessories. Collect payment for services and supplies. May lubricate vehicle, change motor oil, refill antifreeze, or replace lights or other accessories, such as windshield wiper blades or fan belts. May repair or replace tires.

nodes.name: Personal de servicio aeronáutico
nodes.description: Service aircraft with fuel. May de-ice aircraft, refill water and cooling agents, empty sewage tanks, service air and oxygen systems, or clean and polish exterior.

nodes.name: Técnicos de tránsito
nodes.description: Conduct field studies to determine traffic volume, speed, effectiveness of signals, adequacy of lighting, and other factors influencing traffic conditions, under direction of traffic engineer.

nodes.name: Inspectores de transporte
nodes.description: Inspect equipment or goods in connection with the safe transport of cargo or people. Includes rail transportation inspectors, such as freight inspectors, rail inspectors, and other inspectors of transportation vehicles not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Inspectores de aviación
nodes.description: Inspect aircraft, maintenance procedures, air navigational aids, air traffic controls, and communications equipment to ensure conformance with Federal safety regulations.

nodes.name: Inspectores de vehículos, equipos y sistemas de transporte, excepto aviación
nodes.en: Transportation Vehicle, Equipment and Systems Inspectors, Except Aviation
nodes.description: Inspect and monitor transportation equipment, vehicles, or systems to ensure compliance with regulations and safety standards.

nodes.name: Auxiliares de pasajeros
nodes.description: Provide services to ensure the safety of passengers aboard ships, buses, trains, or within the station or terminal. Perform duties such as explaining the use of safety equipment, serving meals or beverages, or answering questions related to travel.

nodes.name: Operadores de cintas transportadoras
nodes.description: Control or tend conveyors or conveyor systems that move materials or products to and from stockpiles, processing stations, departments, or vehicles. May control speed and routing of materials or products.

nodes.name: Operadores de grúas y torres
nodes.description: Operate mechanical boom and cable or tower and cable equipment to lift and move materials, machines, or products in many directions.

nodes.name: Operadores de draga
nodes.description: Operate dredge to remove sand, gravel, or other materials in order to excavate and maintain navigable channels in waterways.

nodes.name: Operadores de guinches y cabrestantes
nodes.description: Operate or tend hoists or winches to lift and pull loads using power-operated cable equipment.

nodes.name: Operadores de carretillas elevadoras
nodes.description: Operate industrial trucks or tractors equipped to move materials around a warehouse, storage yard, factory, construction site, or similar location.

nodes.name: Limpiadores de vehículos y equipos
nodes.description: Wash or otherwise clean vehicles, machinery, and other equipment. Use such materials as water, cleaning agents, brushes, cloths, and hoses.

nodes.name: Peones de carga y manipulación de materiales
nodes.en: Laborers and Freight, Stock, and Material Movers, Hand
nodes.description: Manually move freight, stock, luggage, or other materials, or perform other general labor. Includes all manual laborers not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Trabajadores de reciclaje y recuperación
nodes.description: Prepare and sort materials or products for recycling. Identify and remove hazardous substances. Dismantle components of products such as appliances.

nodes.name: Alimentadores de máquinas
nodes.description: Feed materials into or remove materials from machines or equipment that is automatic or tended by other workers.

nodes.name: Empacadores manuales
nodes.description: Pack or package by hand a wide variety of products and materials.

nodes.name: Repositores y preparadores de pedidos
nodes.description: Receive, store, and issue merchandise, materials, equipment, and other items from stockroom, warehouse, or storage yard to fill shelves, racks, tables, or customers' orders. May operate power equipment to fill orders. May mark prices on merchandise and set up sales displays.

nodes.name: Operadores de compresores y estaciones de bombeo de gas
nodes.en: Gas Compressor and Gas Pumping Station Operators
nodes.description: Operate steam-, gas-, electric motor-, or internal combustion-engine driven compressors. Transmit, compress, or recover gases, such as butane, nitrogen, hydrogen, and natural gas.

nodes.name: Operadores de bombas, excepto de boca de pozo
nodes.description: Tend, control, or operate power-driven, stationary, or portable pumps and manifold systems to transfer gases, oil, other liquids, slurries, or powdered materials to and from various vessels and processes.

nodes.name: Bomberos de boca de pozo
nodes.description: Operate power pumps and auxiliary equipment to produce flow of oil or gas from wells in oil field.

nodes.name: Recolectores de residuos y materiales reciclables
nodes.description: Collect and dump refuse or recyclable materials from containers into truck. May drive truck.

nodes.name: Cargadores de camiones, vagones y barcos
nodes.en: Tank Car, Truck, and Ship Loaders
nodes.description: Load and unload chemicals and bulk solids, such as coal, sand, and grain, into or from tank cars, trucks, or ships, using material moving equipment. May perform a variety of other tasks relating to shipment of products. May gauge or sample shipping tanks and test them for leaks.

nodes.name: Atención al Cliente y Servicios Personales
